name: MachinaERP
short: Project tracking software built specifically for mould manufacturers, from job cards to delivery.
lede: A focused ERP interface for mould manufacturers who needed job-card visibility, delivery tracking and production status without the bloat of generic enterprise tools.
note: Built for a Vasai-based mould manufacturer, entirely in React, and rolled out in 8 weeks.
steps: Discovery
Mapped the real factory workflow: enquiry, job card, mould progress, dispatch and follow-up.
Structure
Reduced the product into clear modules so operators could find work status without training overhead.
Interface
Built dense but readable screens with visual hierarchy for priority, ownership and delivery risk.
Outcome
A faster internal product that feels custom to the manufacturing floor instead of borrowed from another industry.
seoTitle: MachinaERP Case Study | Project Tracking SaaS | MadeOfPixels Studio
seoDesc: How MadeOfPixels Studio built MachinaERP, a React project tracking system for mould manufacturers with job cards, delivery tracking and production dashboards.

name: MadeOfPixels Studio
short: Our own brand, built the same way we build yours.
lede: A brand system designed to feel technical, loud and precise: part machine shop, part creative studio, with a visual language that scales across web, print and social.
note: The six-square mark, the type system and this website are all part of the same identity.
steps: Positioning
Defined the brand around custom craft, sharp execution and refusal to look template-made.
System
Built a tight type, colour, grid and mark system around acid green, black and industrial spacing.
Application
Translated the identity into a website, CTA language, case-study format and repeatable visual assets.
Outcome
A distinct studio presence that sells process, not just polish, and gives every touchpoint a point of view.
seoTitle: MadeOfPixels Studio Identity | Brand Identity Case Study
seoDesc: Brand identity case study: how MadeOfPixels Studio designed its own logo, type, colour and grid system, then applied it across web, print and social.

name: FileLink Platform
short: File management and QR sharing for manufacturing teams.
lede: A file management and QR sharing product for teams that need quick access to documents, drawings and references without digging through folders or chat threads.
note: Designed around low-friction daily use: upload, tag, generate a QR code, share.
steps: Problem
Identified the handoff gap: files existed, but the right person could not always reach the right file quickly.
Flow
Designed upload, tagging, QR generation and sharing flows around low-friction daily use.
Interface
Kept the UI direct: clear file states, copyable links, scannable QR blocks and simple actions.
Outcome
A practical internal platform that makes shared files feel immediate, trackable and easy to trust.
seoTitle: FileLink Platform Case Study | QR File Sharing Web App
seoDesc: Case study: FileLink, a React and Supabase web app for QR file sharing and file management built by MadeOfPixels Studio for manufacturing teams.
